name: radio-group
summary: The dot springs in with a ripple; cards light up and draw a check badge.
props: { value, label, description?, icon?, hint?, disabled? }[]
The choices. `hint` is trailing text such as a price.
Radio dots, selectable cards or a grouped list with ticks.
Stack or lay out side by side (cards share the width).
Disable the whole group (or per option).
Style for the group container (the bordered card in the segmented-list variant).
behavior: Rows squish on press in the default and card variants, and the default dot has extra hitSlop. Disabled options are dimmed and ignore taps.
The selected dot pops on a bouncy spring with a ripple ring. Cards tint their border and pop a self-drawing check; the list variant draws a tick.
A selection tick plays on each change (haptics, on by default).
The group is a radiogroup and each option a radio with checked and disabled state. Descriptions are read as hints.
